The product of letters of the husband ROBEN is 18*15*2*5*14 = $2^3*3^3*5^2*7$.
The same should be the product of letters of the wife’s name. 
We know that the alphabet ‘N’ is common.
So we have the value 14 now.
We need to get $3^3$ from the wife’s name. 
27 as an alphabet is not possible. 
We should either have three multiples of 3 or one multiple of 9 and one multiple of 3. 
Let’s assume there are three multiples of 3.
They can be from 3, 6, 12, 15, 18, 21and 24.
But 15 and 18 are letters in the husband’s name and they can be eliminated.
21 has an extra 7 and can be eliminated. 
We already have the alphabet with code 14 and if we have the alphabet with code 24 there will be $2^4$ which should not be.
So we are left with only 3, 6 and 12.

Now 14 and 9 are there and we must find the other 3 letters whose product must be $2^2*3*5^2$

If they are as two multiples of 5 they can be from among 5, 10, 15 and 20.
But 5 and 15 are already present in the husband’s name.
So only 10 and 20 are possible.
If 10 and 20 both cannot be present as then we will have $2^4$ in the wife’s name which should not be.
So 25 must be present in the wife’s name.
Now we have three letters 14, 9 and 25. The product of the remaining two numbers is 12.
